text: AI tools keep multiplying. The harder problem is no longer choosing one model — it is deciding who does what, where work is handed off, what gets reviewed, and how activity connects to revenue. I documented a practical operating model for ChatGPT, Claude, GitHub, Buffer, analytics and payments: role separation, handoffs, safety gates and the path from distribution to purchase.
